cashback_bonus_cap.note: S$ | S$150 total cashback cap per calendar month, which includes both Bonus cashback & Base cashback earned in the same month. Within this overall limit, Bonus cashback for each of the top 2 local spend categories is capped at S$30 per calendar month.

highlights: Earn up to 5% cashback on your top 2 local spend categories every calendar month across Dining, Shopping, Travel, Transport, Entertainment, and Wellness, calculated and rewarded automatically every month. Otherwise, earn 1% cashback on all other eligible spend. Cashback capped at S$150 per calendar month, which includes both Base cashback and Bonus cashback.
pros: Application is only open to customers between 21-29 years old.
pros: Up to 5% cashback on your top 2 local spend categories every month across Dining, Shopping, Transport and more—no selection required.
pros: 1% cashback on all other eligible spend—no minimum spend required.
pros: 0 FX fees and 5-year annual fee waiver.
pros: Toggle between up to 5% cashback or 1.3 miles per S$1 – Flexibility to switch your reward preference every month.
cons: Boosted earn rates are removed in the 4th month after your 30th birthday.
cons: Cashback is capped at S$150 per calendar month across both Bonus and Base cashback.

Stackable Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new DBS / POSB credit cardmembers only.
Apply and get approved for selected credit cards from DBS and POSB during the promo period and select “Cashline” in your application on the DBS/POSB website (except foreigners) to be eligible for S$100 cash reward.
Receive an additional S$100 cash with a minimum S$188 closing balance accumulated for Cashline withdrawals in the first two statement months upon account opening.

 apply.

extra.description: Live in full colour with the DBS Chromo Card, a lifestyle credit card for 21-29 year-olds that adapts to your spending. Choose between earning up to 5% cashback or 1.3 miles per S$1, which automatically applies to your top 2 local spend categories. Plus, enjoy 0 FX fees and no annual fees for the first 5 years.
